hook: Thirty open-source SEO skills for your coding agent.
hookText: 30 SEO skills for Claude Code and Cursor

beats.say: Ilias Ism open-sourced his daily SEO and AI-search stack for Claude Code and Cursor: thirty skills plus four live MCP servers.
Each skill is one SKILL.md file. The agent reads only its name and description at startup, and opens the full file when your prompt matches.
Instead of audit PDFs, they end in things you can ship: rewritten titles, refreshed posts, robots rules and verified redirect maps.
